chunks: A number from our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Yaqub ibn Yazeed, from Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Aqabiy, with an unbroken chain, said:

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) gave a sermon, so he praised Allah and extolled Him, then said: 'O people! Surely Adam did not give birth to a slave or a bondmaid, and all people are free, but Allah granted some of you authority over others. So whoever had an affliction and bore it patiently in goodness, let him not consider it a favor to Allah, Mighty and Majestic. Indeed, something has occurred, and we are making equality between the black and the red in it.' So Marwan said to Talha and al-Zubayr, 'He has not intended by this other than the two of you.'

He said, 'So he gave each one of them three dinars, and gave a man from the Ansar three dinars, and afterwards a black slave boy came, so he gave him three dinars.' So the Ansari said, 'O Amir al-Mu'minin, this is a slave whom I freed yesterday; do you make me and him equal?' So he said, 'I looked in the Book of Allah and did not find any preference for the sons of Ismail over the sons of Ishaq.'

key_terms.أَحْرَارٌ: Free (plural of free person, opposite of slave)
key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Title of Imam Ali)
key_terms.الْأَسْوَدِ وَ الْأَحْمَرِ: The black and the red (referring to skin color)
key_terms.مَرْوَانُ: Marwan ibn al-Hakam, a key figure in early Islamic history

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about equality between black and red people in his sermon?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights Imam Ali’s (as) egalitarian stance during the Umayyad era, where he explicitly countered tribal and racial prejudices by equating the freed slave with the free Arab in charity distribution. By citing the Quranic precedent of the sons of Ismail and Ishaq, he established that divine favor is not bound by lineage or color, a principle that resonates with the Shia emphasis on spiritual merit over social hierarchy.

en.hubeali: H 14474 – A number from our companions, from Sahl Bin Zyad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Muhammad Bin Ja’far Al-Aqabayy with an unbroken chain said: ‘Amir-ul-Momineenasws gave a sermon, so heasws Praised Allahazwj and Extolled Himazwj, then said: ‘O you people! Surely, Adamas did not give birth to a slave or a bondmaid, and that all of the people are free, but Allahazwj Made some to be in authority over the others. So the one who had an affliction and he bore it patiently in goodness so he should not consider by it as a favour to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic. Indeed! There are things present and we have equality regarding it between the black and the red’. So Marwaan said to Talha and Al-Zubeyr, ‘Heasws has not intended any by this other than the two of you’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So heasws gave each one of them three Dinars, and gave a man from the Helpers three Dinars, and afterwards a black boy came over so heasws gave him three Dinars’. So the Helper said, ‘O Amir-ul-Momineenasws, this is a slave whom I freed yesterday. Youasws have made me and him as equals’. So heasws said: ‘Iasws looked in the Book of Allahazwj, Iasws could not find any preference for the sons of Ismailas over the sons of Is’haaqas’. out of 567
